title: Ziegfeld Roof job in New York and homesickness
summary: Will Vodery and Fort Dabney put Howard to work on the Ziegfeld Roof at $100 a week, but as a young man he got homesick and left.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So then did you go right back to Chicago after you?

No. Went to work. Will Vaudry and, and, uh, a man, a other man. Dabney. You? Fort Dabney. Fort Dabney? Yeah, and Will Vaudry. They put me to work up there, at, uh, Ziegfield Roof. One hundred dollars a week. And I got homesick. I didn't mean to, I'm not.
You were just a kid at this time.
And I got, I got homesick, man. I couldn't stay there.
Weren't you scared in New York at that age?
Scared? Scared? Yeah. Why would I be scared? You were just a child. Well, why would I be scared? Scared? Some woman latch on to you. Ah. No. Well, nothing like that. Why would I be scared, man?
Well, you were in, in a, in a strange city.
